title: ‘I’m Not That Informed on National Security,’ Graham Says in South Carolina Debate
summary: Senator Darline Graham made the remark in a debate against Representative Ralph Norman, her opponent in the runoff election to succeed her brother, Lindsey Graham. Here are five takeaways from the debate.
